function.name: weather_forecast_get_prediction
function.description: Fetches the weather prediction for a specified location and date range, including temperature, precipitation chances, and wind speed. Note that the provided function is in Python 3 syntax.

location.description: The geographical location for which the weather forecast is requested, in the format of 'City, State' or 'City, Country', such as 'Berkeley, CA' or 'London, UK'.

start_date.description: The start date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

end_date.description: The end date for the forecast period, in the format 'YYYY-MM-DD'.

units.description: The unit system used for the weather forecast results.

include_details.description: A flag indicating whether to include detailed forecast information such as hourly data.

### The “Best” Men’s Underwear Styles – A Quick Guide When it comes to men’s underwear, “best” is a mix of comfort, fit, durability, and style. Below is a rundown of the most popular styles, what they’re best for, and key features to look for when shopping. | Style | What It Looks Like | Ideal For | Key Features | |-------|--------------------|-----------|--------------| | **Boxer Briefs** | Long‑legged briefs that cover the hips and thighs. | Everyday wear, sports, travel. | • Full coverage, supportive fit.
• Good for preventing chafing.
• Available in cotton, modal, microfiber, and performance blends. | | **Briefs (Classic)** | Short‑legged, snug fit that sits at the waist. | Classic look, office wear, casual. | • Minimal coverage, great for low‑profile pants.
• Often made from cotton or a cotton‑blend. | | **Boxers** | Loose, breathable, short‑legged. | Loungewear, sleep, light activity. | • Excellent airflow.
• Can be less supportive for active use. | | **Trunks** | Short‑legged, similar to boxer briefs but with a shorter leg. | Modern look, athletic wear, travel. | • Combines support with a sleek silhouette.
• Often made from moisture‑wicking fabrics. | | **Jockstrap** | Supportive waistband with a pouch and a thin elastic strap. | Sports, high‑impact activities. | • Provides excellent support.
• Minimal coverage; good for athletes. | | **Compression Briefs** | Tight, supportive fabric that compresses the lower body. | Recovery, high‑intensity training. | • Improves circulation.
• Usually made from spandex blends. | | **Performance/Tech Underwear** | Made from advanced fabrics (e.g., polyester, nylon, spandex). | Sports, travel, everyday wear. | • Moisture‑wicking, anti‑odor, quick‑dry.
• Often includes antimicrobial treatments. | | **Luxury/Designer** | Premium fabrics (silk, cashmere, high‑grade cotton). | Special occasions, gifting. | • Softest feel, often with unique prints or branding. | --- ## How to Pick the Right Style 1. **Consider Your Activity Level** - **Low‑impact**: Boxers or briefs for relaxed days. - **Moderate**: Trunks or boxer briefs for commuting or light workouts. - **High‑impact**: Jockstrap or compression briefs for sports. 2. **Fabric Matters** - **Cotton**: Breathable, natural, but can absorb sweat. - **Modal / Bamboo**: Soft, moisture‑wicking, eco‑friendly. - **Microfiber / Polyester**: Lightweight, dries fast, often used in performance underwear. - **Spandex / Elastane**: Adds stretch and shape retention. 3. **Fit & Comfort** - Look for a waistband that’s snug but not tight. - Check for a smooth seam construction to avoid irritation. - Try a few sizes; many brands offer a “size‑fit” guide. 4. **Durability & Care** - Performance fabrics often last longer under frequent washing. - Cotton blends may shrink; follow care instructions carefully. 5. **Style & Personal Preference** - If you prefer a low‑profile look, go for briefs. - For a modern, streamlined silhouette, trunks are ideal. - If you like a bit of flair, designer or printed options can add personality. --- ## Top Brands (as of 2026) | Brand | Specialty | Notable Products | |-------|-----------|------------------| | **Calvin Klein** | Classic briefs & boxer briefs | “CK 360” briefs, “CK 360” boxer briefs | | **Uniqlo** | Affordable, high‑quality basics | AIRism briefs, AIRism boxer briefs | | **Under Armour** | Performance tech | UA Tech briefs, UA RUSH boxer briefs | | **Lululemon** | Premium, stretchy | “Fast and Free” briefs, “Fast and Free” boxer briefs | | **Tommy John** | Comfort‑centric | “Second Skin” briefs, “Second Skin” boxer briefs | | **Saxx** | Innovative pouch design | “Underwear of the Future” briefs | | **MeUndies** | Soft, sustainable | “Soft” briefs, “Soft” boxer briefs | | **Hanes** | Budget friendly | Classic briefs, boxer briefs | | **Bamboo Body** | Eco‑friendly | Bamboo modal briefs, bamboo modal boxer briefs | --- ## Quick FAQ | Question | Answer | |----------|--------| | **What’s the difference between boxer briefs and trunks?** | Boxers briefs have longer legs (usually 3–4 inches below the knee), while trunks cut off around the mid‑thigh. Trunks offer a slimmer look. | | **Do I need a pouch?** | A pouch provides support and reduces friction. If you’re active or just want extra comfort, choose underwear with a pouch. | | **Can I wear underwear with tight pants?** | Yes—briefs or boxer briefs are best for tight pants to avoid visible lines. | | **How often should I replace my underwear?** | Every 6–12 months, depending on wear and fabric. Performance underwear may last longer due to durable fibers. | | **Is cotton good for sweaty days?** | Cotton absorbs sweat, which can lead to odor buildup. For hot days, opt for moisture‑wicking fabrics. | --- ### Bottom Line - **For everyday comfort**: Boxer briefs or trunks in a breathable cotton or modal blend. - **For sports or high‑impact activities**: Compression briefs or jockstraps with moisture‑wicking tech. - **For style or gifting**: Designer briefs or luxury fabrics like silk or cashmere. Pick the style that matches your lifestyle, and don’t forget to consider fabric, fit, and care instructions. Happy shopping!
